notes.title: Patch .94
notes.content:
Updated to Unity 5.5

 This should optimize graphics and performance.

Level Updates

9 - Adjusted positioning of destructable rocks to make it more intuitive on how to beat it.

Misc

 Erasing save file with a knife unlocked or secret ending unlocked wouldn't be erased until game restart.
 Modified some camera settings.


-Windows update is out.
-Mac and Linux soon to come.

notes.title: Patch .93
notes.content:
Level Updates

14 - Adjusted some laser timings and positioning.  This level was slightly more difficult than intended for where it is at in the game.
16 - Removed angled fan at the beginning.  It wasn't intuitive enough that you can stop on the angled fan.
19 - Switched ledge location at the end so you can see where you're falling.
26 - Removed spikes on door for collectable.  Wasn't obvious enough there was door that opened there.


Sprite Changes

Exploding Box sprite was updated to be more unique and hopefully standout more.


-Windows update is out.
-Mac and Linux soon to come.
